source.citation: Hartley's studio, West Madison Street, Chicago, multigraph photograph of Frances Macbeth Glessner: five views of her taken at once in two mirrors set at about 75 degrees, about February 1897. Glessner House collection, reproduced in 'The many sides of Frances Glessner', The Story of a House (Glessner House blog), 9 February 2015.
what_it_does_not_supply: marks fine enough to fit (the heads are about 60 px high in the copy held)
what_it_supplies: the profile of her face and the shape of her head from the side and back, as a cross-check on the fitted face
how she dressed her hair in 1897: drawn up to a crown of braids
